summary: Recovered the live PIN canary through G000003 and validated the remaining evidence instead of fabricating contention receipts. The 2-worker G1 requirement is already verified. The 5-worker G1 fixture still has only one of four required distinct loser collisions, and its historical G000002 stale-route abort was incorrectly recorded as terminal NO_ACTION_NEEDED, which makes the unfinished v1 fixture disappear from the new fixed_generation_attention lane. Concurrent work has now added semantic fixed-generation recovery filtering, but the current fast allocator still emits direct PORTFOLIO_PIN_CREATE and does not represent the binding explicit contention-barrier rendezvous before PIN. Materialized two deduplicated control-plane repairs: fast-allocation barrier parity and stale-allocator-abort terminal semantics. No collision was synthesized, no product surface was mutated, and no production /w promotion occurred.
